description: This file defines the Light structure and the LightsObserver class, which manages WebRTC streaming lights via a VSOCK connection, including subscribing to messages and maintaining lights state.

classes.name: Light
classes.description: Represents a light with an ID, color, and type (e.g., backlight, keyboard, notifications).

classes.name: LightsObserver
classes.description: Manages the observation and control of device lights over a VSOCK connection, including subscribing to messages and maintaining lights state.

methods.name: LightsObserver
methods.description: Constructor initializing the observer with port, connection ID, and VSOCK mode.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the observer, establishing connection and beginning message reading.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes a message handler for lights messages.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes a message handler based on its ID.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the observer and connection thread.

methods.name: ReadServerMessages
methods.description: Reads messages from the server in a loop.
